content:
samir: Heads-up — we need a concise compatibility checklist for model-variant fallback behavior that product + infra can rely on. Focus: tokenizer parity, max context length, and tool-calling support across tiers/regions. Current docs are scattered. Any quick proposal?
alex: +1. We should make it actionable for routing rules: binary compat flags so router can decide immediate fallback vs staged conversion.
maria: I can sketch a tiny matrix. Keep it minimal: tokenizer_id, context_limit, toolcall (yes/no), fallback_mode (rewrite/truncate/deny), tier_constraints.
jlee: Also track telemetry events for mismatch reasons so we can prioritize conversions. Events: `fallback_used`, `fallback_reason`, `tokenizer_mismatch`, `context_truncated`, `toolcall_mismatch`.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: ensure fallback variants are registered in /models/catalog and have `compat_flags` populated. Missing flags -> block canary.
samir: rough YAML idea below — feedback?
```yaml
- model_variant: vanguard-7b-q4
  tokenizer: hf-tokenizer-v2
  max_context: 8192
  tool_calling: true
  fallback_mode: rewrite
  allowed_tiers: [hosted, dedicated]
  regions_blocklist: []

- model_variant: lightweight-7b-q4
  tokenizer: hf-tokenizer-v1
  max_context: 4096
  tool_calling: false
  fallback_mode: truncate
  allowed_tiers: [hosted]
  regions_blocklist: [eu-central-1]
```
alex: That looks good. Two suggestions: 1) prefer `fallback_mode: rewrite` only if tokenizer mismatch is minor (mapping table exists). 2) Add `latency_penalty_ms` estimate so router can make cost/latency tradeoffs.
maria: +1 for `latency_penalty_ms`. Also capture `expected_token_delta` to estimate billing impact for conversions.
jlee: UX/Console: we need a small per-route dashboard widget: fallback rate over time, top 3 fallback reasons, avg latency delta when fallback occurs. Make it a single-card mini panel so PMs can see regressions fast.
samir: For quotas: ensure fallback to cheaper variant doesn't circumvent per-customer model quotas (e.g., gold customers pinned to premium model). So add `enforce_pin: true/false` in matrix.
alex: Implementation note: router should evaluate in this order: 1) enforce_pin, 2) region_allowed, 3) compat_flags (tokenizer/tool_calling/context), 4) cost/latency heuristics.
infra-bot: ops-note: add a daily job to validate matrix entries vs actual model metadata: script `scripts/validate_variant_matrix --matrix path --catalog path` should emit warnings for mismatches.
maria: I'll draft a short RFC with the YAML, telemetry events, and dashboard mock. Want volunteers to review before I send it to PMs.
samir: I'll review. @alex @jlee can you peek at the dashboard mock? If we agree, we can land a small beta in canary region next week. :eyes: 
alex: I'll take the dashboard card layout.
jlee: I'll review the telemetry schema and add the agg keys.
samir: thanks all — will track in the RFC and ping when ready.
